issue_context.title: Remove kubescheduler.config.k8s.io/v1alpha1
issue_context.body:
/sig scheduling
/kind cleanup

As we get ready to move to beta, we should first get rid of the v1alpha1 API to reduce maintenance cost.

In particular, this would free us from having to maintain Algorithm Source.

Before I open this for contributors, I would like to know if there are any concerns.
comments: +1. It's a common practice to only keep one alpha release to reduce maintenance efforts, such as kubeadm componentconfig API.

SGTM.

removing v1alpha1, before the beta is out agrees with the table under:
https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/deprecation-policy/#deprecating-parts-of-the-api
see:
> v1alpha1 is removed, "action required" relnote

(it says that alpha1 goes out when alpha2 is released)

for kubeadm's component config we kept them for a while longer and did not follow this guide exactly:

alpha1,2,3 existed at the same time:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/release-1.12/cmd/kubeadm/app/apis/kubeadm

alpha1,2 were both removed with the release of beta1; alpha3 was kept:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/release-1.13/cmd/kubeadm/app/apis/kubeadm

alpha3 was removed with the addition of beta2:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/release-1.15/cmd/kubeadm/app/apis/kubeadm

Hi all, I want to have a try to get familiar with kubernetes api. Is there anything (documents or general commands) I should know before I start the work.

I think this should be similar with #69055

/assign

> Is there anything (documents or general commands) I should know before I start the work.

Better reference [#87628](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/87628) which add scheduler.config.v1alpha2, you can remove v1alpha1 conversely.

review_comments: Could you add unit tests for `Deprecated.AlgorithmProvider` and `Deprecated.PolicyConfigFile`?
Actually, not here, I'll leave a comment somewhere else (#88028)
Sure, I will follow up if the origin assignee does not continue the work.
